source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: One local campground added: Egg Harbor City Lake Campground (city-owned, managed by Renault Winery & Resort from 2026). Birch Grove Park (Northfield) closed in 2019. NJ's unmatched OSM campsites are otherwise private (about 60) or state (High Point's Sawmill Lake and Steam Mill) - NJ holds only 19 entries, so the private and state gaps there are large.

excluded.why: campground closed permanently in 2019 by city council, land reverting to natural state
